newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY FORINT CLOSES DOWN VS DLR, STEADY VS BASKET.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY FORINT CLOSES DOWN VS DLR, STEADY VS BASKET.

text.p: Hungary's forint closed easier against the dollar, weakened by dollar gains against the mark, but the forint remained steady against the National Bank of Hungary"" (NBH) currency basket, dealers said on Friday.
The forint finished at 155.40 to one dollar, down from 155.20/25 at the opening.
"This happened because the dollar firmed (against the mark)," said ABN AMRO's Adam Szilagyi.
The forint floats within the NBH's 4.5 percent intervention range, against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the Ecu.
The forint remained close to the NBH resistance level (bid) on Friday, drifting away from the bid by maximum three pips, dealers said.
Foreign currency futures turnover on the Budapest Commodity Exchange soared to 10.97 billion forints from 5.6 billion forints on Thursday.
Mark and Ecu futures were mostly stable, while dollar futures eased or remained steady.
